mutations.name: a budget entry with no runs passes
kills: ci timing budget fails an entry that matches no runs, so a renamed job cannot pass

mutations.name: a stat at its ceiling fails
kills: ci timing budget passes a stat at its ceiling and fails one over it

mutations.name: a skipped step counts as a sample
kills: ci timing percentiles takes no sample from a skipped job or step

mutations.name: percentiles take the nearest rank instead of interpolating
kills: ci timing percentiles interpolates between the closest ranks
ci timing percentiles summarizes run wall, job, queue and step per event

mutations.name: main lists pushes on every branch
kills: ci timing run selection lists main as pushes to main and views each chosen run
